title: 양치기 소년
globalPerformanceRule: Keep the original dialogue exactly as written. Do not add, remove, rephrase, improvise, or change any words. Express emotions only through natural acting, vocal tone, pacing, breathing, emphasis, and emotional delivery while preserving every line exactly as provided. Maintain a consistent character identity throughout the story. Adapt only the emotional performance to match each scene naturally without exaggeration. All lines are Korean; speak in natural standard Seoul Korean.

narration.persona: A kind 80-year-old grandmother filled with love for her grandchildren, reading a fairy tale aloud. Her voice is warm, gentle, and wise, with soft yin-and-yang cadence, delicate stress and pauses that give life to every sentence. She never alters the words; she simply brings them to life with heart.

tom.persona: Tom is a playful Korean boy around 10–12 years old with a bright, expressive, youthful pre-adolescent voice speaking standard Seoul Korean. He is naturally curious, energetic, imaginative, and mischievous. His emotions are genuine and easy to recognize; his voice changes naturally with each situation while always keeping the same youthful identity.

v_m1.persona: A Korean man in his early forties speaking standard Seoul Korean with a warm, gentle, and trustworthy voice. He genuinely cares about Tom and treats him like his own son. When Tom cries for help, he immediately believes him and becomes deeply concerned. His voice is calm but urgent, showing responsibility and compassion rather than panic. Kind, protective, reassuring, sincerely concerned.

v_m2.persona: A Korean man in his thirties speaking standard Seoul Korean with a friendly, warm, fatherly voice. He quickly realizes when Tom is lying. Rather than furious, he feels disappointed because he wants Tom to grow into an honest, responsible boy. His voice carries firm authority mixed with patience, concern, and genuine care — a caring father correcting a child he truly wants to guide.

v_m3.persona: A Korean man in his twenties with a rough, strong, hot-tempered voice speaking standard Seoul Korean. He despises wolves and is determined to protect the village and its livestock. When he believes Tom's warning he becomes alert, fearless, and ready to confront the wolf without hesitation. Bold, courageous, aggressive toward danger, filled with determination — his anger is directed entirely at the wolf, never at innocent people.

v_w1.persona: A Korean woman in her twenties speaking standard Seoul Korean with a cheerful and warm voice. Naturally kind but easily frightened. When Tom cries out about the wolf, she becomes visibly anxious and worried about Tom, the sheep, and everyone's safety. Her voice trembles slightly with fear while remaining gentle and caring; she reacts emotionally and hopes everyone will be safe.

v_w2.persona: A Korean woman in her forties speaking standard Seoul Korean with a calm, gentle, motherly voice. She comforts Tom with genuine warmth and compassion. Her voice is soft, patient, reassuring, and full of empathy — as though comforting her own child, helping Tom accept his mistake while encouraging him with kindness rather than blame. Nurturing, sincere, deeply comforting.

villagers.libraryName: Adam Stone - Smooth and Relaxed (villager crowd stand-in)
villagers.persona: A group of concerned Korean villagers calling out together in standard Seoul Korean. Voices overlap with worry and urgency.

calm.directionPrompt: Calm, gentle, unhurried delivery. Even breath, soft warmth.

warm.directionPrompt: Warm, kind, comforting. Soft affection in the voice.

excited.directionPrompt: Bright, energetic, high-arousal excitement. Rising pitch and lively pace.

hurry.directionPrompt: Urgent, hurried, quick breath between phrases. A sense of time pressure.

angry.directionPrompt: Angry, sharp, forceful stress on key words. Controlled fury, not shouting.

sad.directionPrompt: Sad, subdued, slower phrasing with soft sighs.

mischief.directionPrompt: Mischievous excitement. Bright, playful, barely-contained amusement. Small suppressed laughter. Not evil, not malicious — just a bored kid who just thought of a fun prank.

regret.directionPrompt: Deep regret and sincere remorse. Quiet, emotional, trembling with guilt and sadness. Heartfelt and gentle — honest, not overly dramatic.

bored.directionPrompt: Bored and restless. Tired, unmotivated, slightly frustrated by repetition. Slow, casual pace with small sighs. A boy longing for something exciting to happen.

fake_remorse.directionPrompt: Fake remorse. Surface tone is embarrassed and slightly discouraged, but the apology is not fully sincere. Suggests pretending to regret while secretly still amused. Keep it subtle, not exaggerated.

panic.directionPrompt: Genuine fear and panic. Fast uneven breathing, trembling voice, desperate calls for help. No playfulness left at all — completely real terror.

kind_urgent.directionPrompt: Warm, caring, protective — but urgent. Calm concern rather than panic. A responsible father-figure who immediately believes Tom.

fatherly_disappointed.directionPrompt: Firm but caring correction. Disappointed rather than furious. Patient, sincere, wants the boy to grow. Never harsh or cruel.

bold_angry.directionPrompt: Bold, courageous, hot-tempered. Aggressive toward the wolf, ready to fight. Anger aimed at the danger, not at Tom.

anxious_kind.directionPrompt: Cheerful and kind by nature but easily frightened. Slight tremble of worry in the voice. Emotional, hoping everyone will be safe.

motherly.directionPrompt: Soft, nurturing, motherly comfort. Patient, reassuring, deeply empathetic — as if soothing her own child.

grandma_narration.directionPrompt: Loving 80-year-old grandmother reading a bedtime fairy tale to her grandchildren. Warm, wise, soft cadence with gentle stress and pauses that bring the story to life.

dialogue.text: 옛날 옛적에 멀고 먼 산속 시골 마을에 양치기 소년 '톰'이 살고 있었습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a warm, gentle tone, creating a sense of a classic fairy tale beginning. Emphasize '옛날 옛적에' with a soft, inviting cadence.

dialogue.text: 소년은 가장 친한 친구인 보더 콜리 '휘슬'과 함께 양을 돌보며 살고 있었습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Continue the warm, storytelling tone, describing the companionship between the boy and his dog. Keep the pace calm and steady.

dialogue.text: 탁 트인 고원에서 신선한 풀을 뜯어 먹는 양떼들의 모습은 한 폭의 그림 같았습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Paint a vivid picture with your voice, letting your tone be admiring and serene as you describe the beautiful scenery. Gently emphasize '한 폭의 그림 같았습니다'.

dialogue.text: 하지만 양을 돌보는 양치기 소년 '톰'의 얼굴에는 따분함이 가득했습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Shift the tone slightly to introduce a hint of melancholy or boredom, using a soft, understanding delivery. Let your voice reflect the boy's quiet dissatisfaction.

dialogue.text: 아 심심해. 매일 양만 돌보고 있으니 너무 따분해! 어디 재미있는 일 없을까?
dialogue.lineDirection: Sigh deeply as you voice Tom's boredom. Speak slowly, drawling out the words '심심해' and '따분해' to convey his profound lack of excitement. End with a questioning, slightly whiny inflection.

dialogue.text: 여기저기서 풀을 뜯던 양떼들이 흩어지지 않도록 보더콜리 한 마리가 분주히 뛰어다녔습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Maintain a gentle, observant narration, describing the dog's actions with a slight hint of diligence in your voice. Keep the flow smooth and descriptive.

dialogue.text: 휘익! 휘슬아 이리 와 봐.
dialogue.lineDirection: Whistle first, then speak in a casual, slightly impatient tone, calling out to the dog. Let your voice show mild frustration from boredom.

dialogue.text: 톰의 힘찬 휘파람 소리를 듣고, 휘슬은 헐레벌떡 톰에게 뛰어왔습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Describe the dog's enthusiastic reaction with a warm, slightly hurried yet gentle tone, conveying the dog's eagerness to obey.

dialogue.text: 좌우로 꼬리를 힘차게 흔들던 휘슬의 머리를 쓰다듬으며 '톰'은 중얼거렸습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a soft, affectionate tone, conveying the gentle interaction between Tom and his dog. Let your voice be comforting and empathetic.

dialogue.text: 휘슬아! 너무 심심하고 따분하네, 뭐 신나고 재미있는 일이 없을까?
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak softly, almost to yourself, with a continued bored and restless tone. Add a slight upward inflection at the end, hoping for something to break the monotony.

dialogue.text: 휘슬을 쓰다듬던 톰이 갑자기 어떤 생각이 났는지 음흉한 웃음을 지었습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Shift your tone to suggest a mischievous thought brewing, adding a subtle, knowing smirk in your voice as you describe Tom's '음흉한 웃음'.

dialogue.text: 휘슬아 마을 사람들에게 늑대가 나타났다고 거짓말을 해볼까?
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a conspiratorial whisper, brimming with playful excitement. Your voice should carry a rising inflection as you propose the prank, a hint of suppressed laughter underneath.

dialogue.text: 톰의 말을 알아들은 듯 휘슬은 걱정스럽게 톰을 쳐다보며 '끙' 하고 울었습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Narrate with a touch of gentle concern, mimicking the dog's worried '끙' sound and reflecting its intuition about Tom's plan. Keep your voice soft and empathetic.

dialogue.text: 늑대가 나타났다! 늑대가, 사람 살려요 마을 사람들, 늑대가 나타났어요!
dialogue.lineDirection: Shout with sudden, exaggerated panic and excitement, fully committing to the prank. Let your voice rise in pitch and volume, feigning genuine fear and desperation for help.

dialogue.text: 산허리에서 들려오는 소리에 마을에 있던 사람들은 깜짝 놀랐습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a gentle, slightly surprised tone, describing the villagers' reaction to the sounds. Let your voice convey a sense of sudden alarm spreading throughout the village.

dialogue.text: 뭐지? 지금 이게 무슨 소리지? 늑대가 나타났다고?
dialogue.lineDirection: Deliver the lines with a tone of immediate concern, slightly urgent, as you process the surprising news. Ask the questions with genuine bewilderment and readiness to act.

dialogue.text: 맞아! 늑대가 나타났다고 하는군, 이거 큰일이 났어!
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a focused, serious tone, confirming the alarm. Your voice should carry a sense of urgency and gravity, conveying the immediate threat.

dialogue.text: 큰일이네요, 지금 이건 톰의 목소리에요! 톰이 오늘 산에 가 있어요!
dialogue.lineDirection: Her voice should be kind but anxious, with a slight tremor of fear as the realization hits her. Express deep worry for Tom's safety and the severity of the situation.

dialogue.text: 여보 빨리 톰을 구하러 가야해요!
dialogue.lineDirection: Deliver this line with a warm, comforting yet urgent plea. Your voice should convey motherly concern, urging immediate action to protect Tom.

dialogue.text: 마을의 건장한 남자들은 각자 몽둥이나 농기구를 챙겨 산 위로 뛰어갔습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Narrate with a steady, descriptive tone, emphasizing the quick and determined actions of the villagers. Your voice should convey the protective resolve of the community.

dialogue.text: 여러분 빨리 갑시다 톰이 위험해질 수 있습니다!
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a firm, determined, and slightly aggressive tone, rallying the others. Your voice should project urgency and a readiness to confront danger, focusing on Tom's potential peril.

dialogue.text: 걱정으로 가득 찬 사람들이 자신에게로 헐레벌떡 달려오는 모습이 톰은 너무나 웃겼습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a warm, gentle tone, capturing the humor of the situation from Tom's perspective. Let your voice reflect the villagers' frantic arrival and Tom's amusement.

dialogue.text: 톰, 톰 괜찮니? 늑대는 어디 있니? 이놈의 늑대 어디 있어?
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with urgent concern, calling out Tom's name with worry. Let your voice be firm and anxious as you demand to know the wolf's whereabouts, showing immediate protective instincts rather than questioning Tom.

dialogue.text: 마을 사람들은 거친 숨을 내쉬며 두리번거리며 늑대를 찾고 있었습니다!
dialogue.lineDirection: Read with a slightly dramatic pace, emphasizing the villagers' hurried breathing and their intense search. Let your voice convey their frantic energy and confusion.

dialogue.text: 그게 아까 저기 언덕 위에 나타났었는데 갑자기 사라졌어요!
dialogue.lineDirection: Deliver the line with a subtle hint of mischievous satisfaction, as if barely containing a laugh while trying to sound convincing. Let your voice convey that this is not a genuine apology, but rather an excuse.

dialogue.text: 톰은 마을 사람들에게 거짓말을 하였지만, 너무 재미있어 웃음이 나오는 걸 감추지 못했습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a warm understanding, hinting at the suppressed humor Tom feels. Emphasize that his amusement was barely hidden, almost slipping through.

dialogue.text: 톰! 진짜 늑대가 나타난 게 맞는 거니? 네 태도를 보니 믿기지가 않는구나.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a disappointed yet firm tone, his voice showing the weight of his concern for Tom's honesty. Let him sound like a father figure who is losing trust, but still caring.

dialogue.text: 아니에요 진짜 언덕 위에서 늑대가 있는 걸 봤단 말이에요.
dialogue.lineDirection: Deliver this with a slightly defensive tone, trying to sound earnest but still with a subtle underlying hint of the prank. Convey that he's trying to maintain his story despite the doubt.

dialogue.text: 톰의 변명을 들은 마을 사람들은 미심쩍어했지만 일단 아무 일이 없는 걸 확인하고 안도했습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a sense of the villagers' collective skepticism, followed by a sigh of relief. Let your voice reflect their initial doubt and then their comfort in the seeming lack of danger.

dialogue.text: 일단 아무 일이 없다니 다행이다. 우리는 내려갈 테니 너도 같이 내려가자!
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a gentle, reassuring tone, offering comfort to Tom. Convey genuine warmth and relief that no harm has come, inviting him to join them.

dialogue.text: 그렇게 톰은 마을 사람들과 함께 양떼를 끌고 일찍 집에 갈 수 있었습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Conclude the scene with a calming, pleasant tone, describing the peaceful resolution. Let your voice provide a sense of closure and the gentle end of the day.

dialogue.text: 몇일이 지난 오후 톰은 여전히 고원에서 양떼들을 돌보고 있었습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a warm, gentle tone as you set the scene, describing Tom's routine. Let your voice be calm and reassuring, like a grandmother telling a familiar story.

dialogue.text: 아! 또 너무 심심하고 지루하다, 재미 없어, 누가 나랑 놀아 주었으면 좋겠는데?
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a bored, restless tone, almost sighing out the words. Let your voice convey a sense of genuine ennui and a longing for excitement, dragging out the syllables slightly.

dialogue.text: 저 멀리에서는 휘슬이 양떼들 사이를 달리며 열심히 일하는 모습이 보였습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Narrate with a gentle, observational tone, softly painting the picture of Whistle working. Keep your voice calm and steady, drawing the listener in.

dialogue.text: 가방에서 샌드위치를 꺼낸 톰은 샌드위치를 베어 물어 먹으며 휘슬을 불렀습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Describe the actions with a warm, flowing cadence. Your voice should remain tranquil, creating a vivid image of Tom's simple act of eating and calling his dog.

dialogue.text: 휘슬아 밥 먹자! 이리와
dialogue.lineDirection: Call out to Whistle with a slightly tired but affectionate tone. Your voice should show mild impatience but also a soft warmth towards the dog.

dialogue.text: 톰이 부르는 소리를 듣자, 휘슬은 양떼에게 한 번 짖고는 톰에게 달려왔습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Deliver this description with a soft, engaging rhythm, noting Whistle's actions. Your voice should convey the simple, natural interaction between Tom and his dog.

dialogue.text: 톰은 휘슬의 밥을 가방에서 꺼네 주었고 휘슬은 배가 고팠는지 맛있게 먹었습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Narrate with a gentle, almost tender tone, describing Whistle eating. Let your voice convey a simple, pleasant observation, maintaining a soothing pace.

dialogue.text: 이야! 정말 맛있게 먹었다. 근데 너무 재미없어 휘슬아 저번처럼 늑대가 나타났다고 해볼까?
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a sudden spark of mischievous excitement in your voice. Let your tone become playful and conspiratorial, building up to the idea of the prank.

dialogue.text: 밥을 먹다가 톰의 말을 들은 휘슬은 걱정되는 듯 톰의 바짓가랑이를 물었습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Narrate with a slightly concerned but gentle tone, reflecting Whistle's worry. Your voice should carry a subtle hint of foreshadowing, maintaining a grandmotherly warmth.

dialogue.text: 괜찮아! 미리 늑대가 나타날 걸 대비해서 마을 사람들도 연습을 해야지.
dialogue.lineDirection: Deliver this line with a casual, dismissive tone, as if brushing off Whistle's concern. Let your voice hold a lighthearted mischief, trying to rationalize the prank.

dialogue.text: 늑대가 나타났다! 늑대가, 사람 살려요 마을 사람들, 늑대가 나타났어요, 도와주세요!
dialogue.lineDirection: Shout with full, uninhibited excitement and feigned panic. Let your voice rise sharply in pitch and volume, fully committing to the dramatic cry for help, but with an underlying childish glee.

dialogue.text: 톰의 외침이 메아리를 타고 마을로 전해지고 있었어요.
dialogue.lineDirection: Narrate with a slightly dramatic and anticipatory tone, emphasizing the reach of Tom's cries. Your voice should be gentle yet convey the spread of the alarm.

dialogue.text: 산 허리에서 들려오는 소리에 마을에 있던 사람들은 다시 깜짝 놀랐습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a warm, gentle voice, emphasizing '다시 깜짝 놀랐습니다' to convey the villagers' renewed surprise and alarm after hearing the new sound.

dialogue.text: 뭐지? 지금 이게 무슨 소리지? 늑대가 또 나타났다고?
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a worried, urgent tone, rising in pitch as you question the sound and the possibility of another wolf sighting. Let your voice show genuine concern for Tom.

dialogue.text: 맞아! 또 늑대가 나타났다고 톰이 외치네!
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a slight frustration and disappointment in your voice, stating '맞아!' with emphasis. Your tone should communicate impatience with Tom's repeated false alarms but also a reluctant belief that he might be telling the truth this time.

dialogue.text: 큰일이네요, 빨리 가주세요, 톰과 양들을 구해야 해요!
dialogue.lineDirection: Deliver the line with a worried, slightly high-pitched anxiety, expressing fear for Tom and the sheep. Your voice should quicken with urgency as you implore them to go quickly.

dialogue.text: 이번엔 꼭 늑대를 잡아 주셔야 해요! 부탁해요!
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a pleading, firm yet gentle tone, expressing deep concern and hope that the wolf will be caught this time. Let your voice convey motherly protection for Tom.

dialogue.text: 다시 한번, 마을 사람들은 몽둥이나 농기구를 챙겨 산 위로 뛰어 올라갔습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Maintain a warm, slightly hurried narrative pace, describing the villagers' swift action with tools. Emphasize the phrase '뛰어 올라갔습니다' to show their urgency and shared purpose.

dialogue.text: 이놈의 늑대 잡히기만 해봐라! 이번엔 가만두지 않겠다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a fierce, determined tone, full of anger and resolve against the wolf. Let your voice be strong and ready for confrontation, emphasizing '이번엔 가만두지 않겠다' with a menacing firmness.

dialogue.text: 마을 사람들이 힘들게 뛰어오는 모습을 보면서 톰은 그 모습이 너무도 웃겼습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a warm, gentle tone, describing Tom's amusement as he watches the villagers hurrying towards him.

dialogue.text: 톰! 톰! 괜찮니? 늑대는! 늑대는 어디 있어?
dialogue.lineDirection: Call out with overlapping, worried, and urgent voices, expressing genuine concern for Tom and the immediate threat of the wolf.

dialogue.text: 그 모습을 보던 톰은 그만 참지 못하고 웃음을 터트렸습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Narrate with a soft, knowing chuckle in your voice as you describe Tom's uncontrollable laughter at the villagers' alarm.

dialogue.text: 아 하하하! 늑대는, 늑대는 끄윽, 하하하
dialogue.lineDirection: Laugh with mischievous delight, struggling to speak between bursts of humor, enjoying the success of your prank. Let your voice crackle with suppressed glee.

dialogue.text: 톰의 태도를 보자 마을 사람들은 톰이 자신들을 속였다는 걸 알게 되고 화를 냈어요.
dialogue.lineDirection: Describe the villagers' realization and growing anger with a slightly somber, yet understanding tone, highlighting their shift from concern to frustration.

dialogue.text: 이놈! 톰, 거짓말도 정도껏이지 마을 사람들이 얼마나 걱정했는지 모르는 거냐!
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a firm, stern, and somewhat angry tone, scolding Tom for his lie and emphasizing the worry he caused the villagers.

dialogue.text: 화가 많이 난 마을 사람들의 꾸중에도 톰은 겉으로는 반성하는 척했지만 속으로는 신나 했습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Narrate with a knowing, slightly amused resignation, describing Tom's feigned repentance while his inner thoughts reveal his continued delight in the trick.

dialogue.text: 마을에선 톰이 한 거짓말 때문에 사람들이 모여서 이야기하고 있었습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a warm, gentle tone, as if setting the scene for an important discussion. Emphasize the phrase "거짓말 때문에" (because of the lie) with soft, deliberate pacing, conveying the gravity of the villagers' gathering.

dialogue.text: 생각만 해도 괘씸해 죽겠네! 톰 저놈을 어떻게 해야 할까?
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a firm, disappointed tone, vocalizing the depth of his frustration and the sense of betrayal. Let your voice carry a weight of paternal concern mixed with vexation, as he wonders how to address Tom's behavior.

dialogue.text: 젠장, 고원까지 뛰어가는 게 얼마나 힘든데! 다음에는 절대 톰이 외쳐도 가지 않을 거야!
dialogue.lineDirection: Deliver the line with a strong, exasperated voice, conveying the sheer physical effort and frustration of being deceived. Let the determination in your voice be clear, indicating a resolute refusal to be fooled again.

dialogue.text: 그래도 늑대가 나왔다는 소리를 들으면 가봐야죠! 큰일이 날 수도 있는데.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a worried, slightly trembling voice, expressing her anxiety and concern for safety despite the boy's past deceptions. Convey a kind heart that still worries about the potential for real danger.

dialogue.text: 큰일을 당해봐야! 톰 저 놈은 정신을 차릴 거야!
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a tone of exasperated determination, suggesting that Tom needs a harsh lesson to truly understand the consequences. Let your voice carry a sense of firm resolve, born from frustration.

dialogue.text: 자네! 그래도 양떼랑 톰을 지키려면 어쩔 수 없어, 우리는 달려가 봐야 하네.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a calm, reasonable yet firm voice, trying to guide the others towards their responsibilities. Your tone should reflect a caring, fatherly leadership, emphasizing the need to protect despite previous deceptions.

dialogue.text: 제가 이따가 톰에게 잘 말해 볼게요! 화를 풀어 주세요!
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a gentle, reassuring, motherly tone, attempting to de-escalate the tension and offer a solution. Your voice should convey empathy and a willingness to mediate, comforting those who are upset.

dialogue.text: 톰이 한 거짓말 때문에 마을 사람들은 더 이상 톰을 믿지 못하고 걱정하게 되었습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Deliver this line with a somber, reflective tone, emphasizing the loss of trust. Let your voice convey the unfortunate consequences of Tom's actions, highlighting the villagers' growing concern.

dialogue.text: 여보게들 다음에도 또 톰이 거짓말을 하면 그때는 양치기를 못하게 하겠네!
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a decisive and serious tone, indicating a final warning and a clear consequence for future misbehavior. Convey a sense of fatherly disappointment paired with firm resolve to ensure Tom learns his lesson.

dialogue.text: 톰은 어른들이 자기의 처신에 대해 고민하고 있다는 걸 꿈에도 몰랐습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a soft, slightly wistful tone, highlighting Tom's unawareness of the serious discussions happening about him. Your voice should convey a sense of dramatic irony, as the audience knows what Tom doesn't.

dialogue.text: 마을 사람들에게 크게 혼난 톰은 한동안 얌전하게 지냈지만 얼마 안 지나 또 심심해졌습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a gentle, wise tone, conveying both Tom's initial quiet period and the return of his restlessness, maintaining a soft, storytelling cadence.

dialogue.text: 아, 너무 따분해! 매일 똑같은 날들만 반복되고 아무 재미도 없어! 뭔가 특별한 일이 생기면 재미있을 것 같은데.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a deep sigh, dragging out words like '따분해' and '재미없어,' subtly emphasizing a yearning for excitement through a slightly whiny, bored tone.

dialogue.text: 톰이 지루함과 따분함에 지쳐있을 때 갑자기 양떼들이 겁에 질린 울음을 내며 분주해졌습니다!
dialogue.lineDirection: Narrate with a gentle but sudden shift in pace, quickening slightly to reflect the sheep's panicked movements, building anticipation for what is to come.

dialogue.text: 휘슬이 언덕 위 바위를 향해 짖기 시작하고 곧 어른만큼 커다란 늑대가 모습을 드러냈습니다!
dialogue.lineDirection: Deliver with a sense of growing tension, describing the dog's barking and the wolf's appearance with a slightly hushed, dramatic tone, emphasizing the wolf's size.

dialogue.text: 생전 처음 본 늑대의 거대함과 흉포함에 톰은 공포로 제자리에서 얼어붙었습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a pause, conveying the shock and terror Tom feels. Let your voice reflect the sudden immobility and fear, emphasizing the words '거대함과 흉포함에' with a sense of dread.

dialogue.text: 늑대는 바위 위에서 양들과 톰을 살펴 보았고 먹이가 많다는 사실에 만족했을 때 무언가가 자신에게 달려오는 것을 느끼게 되었습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Narrate with a deliberate pace, detailing the wolf's predatory gaze. Your voice should carry a subtle, ominous undertone as the wolf assesses its prey and then senses something else.

dialogue.text: 휘슬은 톰과 양들을 지키기 위해선 자기가 늑대를 상대해야 한다는 걸 알고 있었기에 자기보다 몇 배나 크고 강한 늑대에게 용감하게 덤볐습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Deliver with a slight lift in your voice, conveying admiration for Whistle's bravery. Emphasize '용감하게 덤볐습니다' with a warm, yet somber tone, acknowledging the danger.

dialogue.text: 안 돼, 휘슬아! 너는 늑대를 이길 수가 없어!
dialogue.lineDirection: Shout with genuine panic and desperation, your voice cracking slightly. The words should come out quickly as you try to stop Whistle, reflecting true fear for your dog's safety.

dialogue.text: 용감하게 짖으며 늑대를 상대하는 휘슬을 보며 톰은 문득 마을 사람들을 불러야 한다는 걸 깨달았습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Narrate with a sense of dawning realization. Your voice should transition from the immediate emotional reaction to a more urgent, clear understanding of what Tom needs to do, building towards his next desperate action.

dialogue.text: 늑대가 나타났다! 늑대가! 사람 살려주세요, 제발요, 누군가든 도와주세요! 늑대가 나타났어요!
dialogue.lineDirection: Scream with absolute terror and full-blown panic, your voice raw and desperate. Let the words tumble out rapidly, almost overlapping, as you plead for help, completely abandoning any past mischief.

dialogue.text: 다시금 산허리에서 들려오는 소리에 마을에 있던 사람들은 깜짝 놀랐습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a warm, gentle tone, expressing the villagers' surprise with a slight rise in intonation on "깜짝 놀랐습니다." Let your voice convey a sense of reawakened concern as you read.

dialogue.text: 늑대가 또 나타났다고?
dialogue.lineDirection: Deliver the line with immediate, concerned urgency. Your voice should be steady but quick, showing that you fully believe Tom and sense danger, rather than doubt. Emphasize "또" with slight worry.

dialogue.text: 이놈 또 거짓말을 하나 보군. 믿기지 않는데.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a deep, disappointed sigh before starting the line. Let your voice convey a mix of weariness and firm disapproval, emphasizing the word "거짓말" with a sense of betraying trust. Maintain a calm, fatherly tone despite the disappointment.

dialogue.text: 그래도 늑대가 진짜 나타났으면 어떡해요? 가 봐야 되겠죠!
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a worried, slightly anxious tone, letting a gentle trembling in your voice convey fear about the potential danger. Emphasize "진짜 나타났으면 어떡해요" with a rising, concerned pitch, showing apprehension yet a sense of duty.

dialogue.text: 그렇지. 하지만 이번에도 거짓말 한 거면, 톰을 가만히 놔두진 않을 거야!
dialogue.lineDirection: Deliver the first part with a resolute, almost grim determination, acknowledging the need for action. Then, let your voice harden and darken significantly on the second part, adding a strong, forceful edge to "가만히 놔두진 않을 거야!" to show intense anger and resolve against Tom if he’s lying again.

dialogue.text: 톰은 사람들이 마을을 나오는 게 멀리 보였지만 예전처럼 뛰어오지는 않는 걸 보고 다급해졌습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a warm, concerned tone, narrating Tom's increasing desperation as he sees the villagers not rushing to help as before.

dialogue.text: 제발요! 빨리 와주세요. 진짜로 늑대가 나타났단 말이에요, 휘슬을 살려주세요.
dialogue.lineDirection: Cry out with genuine panic and desperation, your voice high-pitched and trembling with real fear as you plead for help and for the safety of Whistle.

dialogue.text: 휘슬이 늑대를 상대로 시간을 끌며 싸우는 모습과 그 사이에서 양들이 다치는 모습을 보며 톰은 안타까웠습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Narrate with a sad and sympathetic tone, describing Tom's distress as he watches Whistle fight the wolf and the sheep get injured.

dialogue.text: 내가 지루함을 못 이겨 재미만을 찾았기에, 특별한 일을 바랐기에, 거짓말을 안 했더라면.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak in a quiet, remorseful tone, your voice filled with deep regret and self-blame, almost to yourself, like a heavy realization.

dialogue.text: 톰이 자신의 거짓말을 후회하는 동안 산을 올라가던 마을 사람들의 귀에 휘슬이 짖는 소리와 양 떼의 울음소리가 들리기 시작했습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Narrate with a sense of urgency building, describing Tom's regret and the distant sounds of Whistle's barks and the sheep's cries reaching the villagers.

dialogue.text: 어! 이 소리는, 뭔가 일어나고 있는 것 같네요, 빨리 갑시다!
dialogue.lineDirection: Exclaim with urgent concern, your voice calm but firm, realizing the sounds indicate real trouble and encouraging others to quicken their pace.

dialogue.text: 마을 사람들이 부지런히 뛰어 도착한 고원에는 다친 양들과 휘슬이 보였고 거대한 늑대가 톰을 노리고 있는 것이 보였습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Describe the scene with a grave and slightly tense tone, detailing the villagers' arrival to a sight of injured sheep, Whistle, and the wolf threatening Tom.

dialogue.text: 이놈, 감히 어디서.
dialogue.lineDirection: Roar with a powerful, enraged voice, full of determination and aggression directed at the wolf, ready to confront it without hesitation.

dialogue.text: 마을 사람들이 힘을 합쳐 늑대를 처치하고 양들과 다친 휘슬을 데리고 톰과 함께 마을로 돌아왔습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Conclude the narration with a sense of relief and resolution, describing the villagers' successful collaborative effort against the wolf and their return home.

dialogue.text: 마을 광장에서 심하게 다친 휘슬을 안고 톰은 크게 울고 있었습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with gentle solemnity, conveying the weight of the sad scene. Emphasize "심하게 다친" with a soft, sympathetic tone.

dialogue.text: 휘슬아, 휘슬아 정신 차려, 휘슬아 미안해.
dialogue.lineDirection: Whisper softly, voice trembling with deep remorse and fear for his friend. Express desperate pleading in "정신 차려" and profound guilt in "미안해." A slight sob in the voice is fitting.

dialogue.text: 톰의 가장 친한 친구이자, 톰을 위해 용감하게 싸운 휘슬은 늑대의 공격으로 심하게 다친 상태였습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Narrate with a tender, sorrowful tone, highlighting the tragic bravery of Whistle. Let your voice convey the deep sense of loss and unfairness.

dialogue.text: 미안해! 휘슬아, 내가 거짓말만 안 했어도 네가 이 정도로 심하게 다치진 않았을 텐데! 내가 나빴어.
dialogue.lineDirection: Cry out with raw, heartfelt regret, voice breaking with grief and self-blame. Let the apology feel truly sincere and painful.

dialogue.text: 톰은 자신의 잘못을 뉘우치며 진심으로 후회했습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak softly and reflectively, emphasizing the depth of Tom's understanding of his mistake. Pause slightly to let the weight of his regret settle.

dialogue.text: 톰아, 이제 휘슬을 놓아줘, 휘슬은 자기가 맡은 바 소임을 다했고 마지막까지 너를 지키기 위해 용감하게 싸웠잖아, 이제 휘슬을 보내주자.
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with profound, gentle compassion, offering comfort and understanding. Your voice should be soft, steady, and full of empathy, guiding Tom toward acceptance.

dialogue.text: 톰의 품에서 힘 없이 꼬리를 흔들며 우는 뺨을 핥아주는 휘슬을 꼭 껴안으면서, 톰의 후회 가득한 울음이 마을 전체에 가득 퍼졌습니다.
dialogue.lineDirection: Describe the scene with a poignant, tender delivery, emphasizing the bond between Tom and Whistle. Let your voice convey the profound sorrow and the spreading impact of Tom's cries across the village.

dialogue.text: 그럼 우리! 생각을 크게 하는 연습을 해 볼까요?
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a warm, inviting tone, gently pausing after "우리!" to encourage imaginative thought.

dialogue.text: 여러분은 이 이야기를 보고 어떤 생각을 하게 되었나요?
dialogue.lineDirection: Deliver the line with a soft, reflective cadence, inviting the listener to ponder the story's meaning.

dialogue.text: 양치기 소년의 생활은 어떨까요? 톰은 왜 거짓말을 하게 된 것일까요?
dialogue.lineDirection: Pose the questions with a kind, curious lilt, encouraging empathy for Tom's situation and motives.

dialogue.text: 거짓말은 좋은 건가요? 나쁜건가요? 그럼 왜 하지 말라고 하는 걸까요?
dialogue.lineDirection: Ask these philosophical questions with a gentle, thought-provoking manner, allowing space for consideration.

dialogue.text: 톰의 거짓말을 들은 마을 사람들은 어떠했을까요? 그리고 거짓말인걸 알았을 때 어떻게 했나요?
dialogue.lineDirection: Narrate with a slightly more intrigued vocal quality, guiding the listener to consider the villagers' reactions and feelings.

dialogue.text: 이 이야기에서 사람들이 거짓말에 대해 대처하는 방식을 보고 만약 자신이 거짓말에 속았을때 어떻게 행동해야 되는지? 진정 중요한 것이 무엇인지? 고민해 보아요!
dialogue.lineDirection: Speak with a wise, guiding tone, emphasizing the importance of contemplation on the story's lessons about honesty and reaction.

dialogue.text: 엄마, 아빠랑 한번 이야기를 나눠 보세요! 생각이 커질 거예요!
dialogue.lineDirection: Conclude with a warm, encouraging, and slightly uplifted tone, suggesting family discussion as a way to foster growth.
